canonical_name: Cayley-Hamilton theorem for finite square matrices over a commutative ring
literal_source_claim_zh: 矩阵满足其特征多项式
literal_source_claim_en: A matrix satisfies its characteristic polynomial.
canonical_statement: Every finite square matrix over a commutative ring is annihilated by its characteristic polynomial.
canonical_claim: For every finite square matrix A over a commutative ring, evaluating det(X I - A) at A in the matrix algebra yields the zero matrix.
statement_blocker: The intake-selected conventional target, det(X I - A) convention, evaluation semantics, empty-index and zero-ring boundaries, imports, expression fingerprint, and mutations are self-tested; master acceptance is pending.
